category_edits.rationale: Blend 90% current GRU state with 10% normalized recency-weighted prefix mean (half-life five interactions), preserving causal readout during training and inference across all four datasets. The generated predictor imports this model class, so it automatically uses the updated aggregation. All other model and training settings remain unchanged.

response.change_summary: Replace full recency pooling with a 90/10 GRU-state and recency-pooling blend in the shared model class.
